exposure: various drugs used to treat neonatal sepsis
cohort: 175 neonates admitted to a sick newborn care unit with neonatal sepsis at a tertiary care hospital in Uttarakhand.
finding: Parenteral antibiotics (ampicillin plus gentamicin) and vasopressors were the most commonly prescribed drugs for neonatal sepsis, with doses and duration generally adhering to the AIIMS protocol, and a 5.71% rate of adverse drug reactions observed.
followup_time: Duration of hospital stay (not explicitly stated)
